data.one_liner: Shows a circular profile picture with initials, optional image and tooltip.
data.what_it_does: The widget generates a profile avatar using the first letters of a name and assigns a background color based on the name. You can optionally provide an image URL, enable random colors, show a tooltip, or display a role label.
use_when: You need simple user avatars with initials
You want automatic color generation without custom logic
avoid_when: You require advanced avatar features like clustering or animations
You need extensive styling beyond radius, font size, and background color
weaknesses: No built‑in image caching or loading placeholders
